dailyHeadline.headline: Breaking: Local study shows 100% of people who drink water eventually suffer fatal health outcomes.
dailyHeadline.explanation: This plays on a flawed correlation vs causation argument. While true that all humans die, water consumption is not the structural cause of mortality.

educationalNews.title: How to Spot a Confirmation Bias Trap
educationalNews.snippet: We naturally want to believe stories that prove us right. Learn the 3 questions to ask yourself whenever a headline makes you instantly angry or happy.

educationalNews.title: Data Manipulation: The Graph Danger Zone
educationalNews.snippet: Y-axis scaling tricks can make tiny variations look like world-ending crises. See real-world examples of misleading corporate charts analyzed.
